fees.note: From the park's rates page (read 2026-10-14). Winter (November 1 to April 30): $75 a day for a Choice site up to $134 for an Ultimate site, the 2025-26 prices, which still hold for 2026-27. January to March is by the month only; November and April also sell months at $1,085-1,630 plus electric, less for cash or check. Summer (May 1 to October 31): Choice $65, Prime $68, Select $80, Superior $94 and Ultimate $105 a day. Rates are for 2 people ($5 a day each extra). Holidays (Memorial Day, July 4, Labor Day) need 3 nights and cost $5 a night more. Deposit: a day's rent for under a week, $250 for a week to a month, $500 for 2-6 months; cancel 14 days ahead (30-45 days for a month or more), less a $50-250 fee. Full rent is due on arrival, with no refund for leaving early.
